entries.title: Psalms 23:1
segments: <<A Psalm of David.>> Jehovah is my shepherd; I shall not want.

entries.title: Psalms 23:2
segments: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures; He leadeth me beside still waters.

entries.title: Psalms 23:3
segments: He restoreth my soul: He guideth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.

entries.title: Psalms 23:4
segments: Yea, thou I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil; for thou art with me; Thy rod and thy staff, they comfort me.

entries.title: Psalms 23:5
segments: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: Thou hast anointed my head with oil; My cup runneth over.

entries.title: Psalms 23:6
segments: Surely goodness and lovingkindness shall follow me all the days of my life; And I shall dwell in the house of Jehovah for ever.
